headline: US Preopen: Semiconductor Pressure Intensifies, Broad Market Rotation Continues
summary: US premarket shows intensified semiconductor pressure (SOXX -5.16%, MU -12.09%) while Dow futures hold positive (+0.09%). VIX at 16.20 confirms no systemic crisis. The pre-holiday large-cap concentration pattern seen in KOSPI (-6.37%) is transmitting to US markets.

key_signals.note: Intensifying from -2.23% in prior regular session
Memory semiconductor under severe pressure. Direct read-through to SK Hynix
Dow strength confirms rotation, not systemic crisis
Fear index remains subdued. No panic
Won strength sustained. Positive for foreign inflows

next_check_conditions: SOXX recovery above -3% → semiconductor pressure easing
SOXX below -5% → further intensification, gate retest risk rises
MU recovery above -10% → SK Hynix shock moderating
VIX above 18 → caution returning, confidence downgrade
data_limits: Premarket data only. Regular session direction may differ. Pre-holiday (Constitution Day July 17) may amplify moves. Next KRX session July 20 (Mon) — 3-day gap.
